## Lineage
Usually treated as descended from **Konstantinas**, a son of Algirdas by his first wife Maria of Vitebsk, though some genealogists make him a son of Karijotas (verify parentage). The princes of the Orthodox, Ruthenian elder line, passed over in 1377. [Record]

## Feuds & alliances
Partisans of [Švitrigaila](../characters/svitrigaila.qmd) in the 1430s; the [Czartorysk truce](../events/ev_czartorysk_truce.qmd) of 1 Sep 1431 followed the Polish invasion of Volhynia. Enemies of the Kęstutaičiai, in line with the graph's edge for 1440.

## Fate across the books
- **V:** the Czartoryski brothers, with council lords behind them, murder [Žygimantas](../characters/zygimantas.qmd) at Trakai on Palm Sunday, 20 Mar 1440 (chs. 21–22). The first Kęstutaitis to rule was murdered by Uliana's sons; the last is murdered by Maria's grandsons. [Record for the killers (VLE), saga for the framing]
- The Iron Wolf's last howl rises from the lake as the pack of the dead mourns the prince they were first sworn to.
